title: Why is the Cheesecake Factory at the center of the latest culture war?
description: A joke by former President Obama has gone viral and received backlash from the Trump administration as the issue of affordability looms large over next week's midterm elections.

title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
description: Alaska's governor ordered an investigation into claims that Dems recruited a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. And, Hegseth ousted an Army general as the U.S. prepares for potential attacks on Iran.

title: 'Affordability? For who?' Voters decide between helping homeowners or public services
description: Candidates across the U.S. have paid lip service to affordability issues. In Florida, the question of how to save voters money, and at what cost, is literally on the ballot.

title: 2026 midterm election voter guides: Find local resources in your community
description: NPR member stations are gathering information for voters — from voter guides down to local races. Scroll through to find your state and the resources available from your local member station.

title: For voters from immigrant families and new citizens, voting is bigger than themselves
description: While many young voters are focused on the cost of living in the election, for some from immigrant families, the political calculation — and their votes — is often about even more than the economy.

title: Here are the Senate races to watch ahead of Election Day
description: The competitive map for control of the U.S. Senate has expanded considerably in the final days before Election Day. Here's a ranking of those competitive races from most likely to flip to least likely.

title: Democrats seek to weaken the Republican lead in state legislatures
description: Republicans control 10 more state legislatures than Democrats. That's where most laws on taxes, abortion, crime and schools are made.

title: Websites pretending to be local news are boosting Democratic candidates
description: The websites of unknown origin are targeting key U.S. House races. They are getting picked up by ChatGPT's responses but Google's products avoid promoting them.

title: How powerful is Elon Musk? How his political influence compares to past U.S. moguls
description: Critics say the tech entrepreneur's enormous wealth has given him too much political power. But when stacked up against other notable American moguls, historians say he's not unique.

title: Justice Department issues subpoenas to California election workers
description: Grand jury subpoenas sent to election workers in Los Angeles come amid escalating tensions between the Trump administration and California election officials over the state's voter rolls.
